title: See the Individual, Not the Group
description: When thinking about other groups: - Pause assumptions: Ask yourself, "Am I generalizing based on the group?" - Get personal: Interact with individuals from the group to learn about their unique experiences. - Stay curious: Challenge stereotypes by seeking real, diverse examples. Example: If you think "All people from X group act this way," question that thought and find real-world exceptions.
